date-picker-month._comment: OrigamDatePickerMonth.vue announces itself under its OWN prefix (`date-picker-month`, its file name), not under `date-picker__month` the way date-picker.json's `month` BEM child assumes (issue #508, case 1 — 'the BEM prefix takes the sub-component's name'). `weekday` had a dormant twin under date-picker.json; `day` and `weeks` were never authored anywhere. Values below are the component's pre-existing literal fallback (.85rem), carried over unchanged so wiring this channel does not also change the render.
